title: 10,000 Small Businesses in Dallas: Goldman Sachs
description: Goldman Sachs 10,000 Small Businesses helps small businesses create jobs and economic opportunity by providing greater access to business education, financial capital and business support services. Learn more: http://link.gs.com/H6K8

asr.full_text: What this program does is it allows those individuals to go back to school in a real way. It's a way to grow their business and to write that business plan and to be disciplined. And if you do that and you have a good idea and you're going to work hard, you're going to succeed here. And so that's why I'm excited about it. Our guiding principle in this country is equality of opportunity. 10,000 small businesses is a big part of that. I'm Shawn Dollar, owner of Sturm Welding, based in Pilot Point, Texas. That makes me a woman of steel. We service the local farmers and ranchers. We supply items that they need on a regular basis for feeding and watering their animals. I want my company to grow and I want to cultivate my people into leaders so that they can take what they know and teach other people and keep the cycle going. Before the program I was not confident in the decisions that I made, on a day-to-day basis. The Goldman Sachs 10,000 Small Businesses Program, it gave me the steps to get there, so now I have a plan for growth. Our revenues have increased 26% since I graduated, and we're on target to double our sales for the next year. The Goldman Sachs 10,000 Small Business Program brings small businesses a level of skills, capital, that education, the ability to network. It's a huge win for our entire community. I never feel better about the prospects of the United States than when I hear a small business person describe their business opportunity, her commitment. And when you see that you begin to be very, very secure that the American dream is secure for another generation. I don't know.

annotation.contextual_rationale: This video is non-scam content because it profiles Goldman Sachs' 10,000 Small Businesses program as business education, access to capital, support services, networking, and workshops. The participant's 26% revenue increase and plan to double sales are presented as a testimonial about her business rather than a guaranteed investment return offered to viewers. The branding and interview graphic support a corporate promotional context, while the described material does not show a deceptive solicitation or required viewer transaction.
annotation.fine_grained_rationale: N03 is supported because the central content concerns business education, business planning, skills, networking, and operational support for small businesses.

evidence.observation: The description presents the program as providing business education, financial capital, and business support services to small businesses.
